title: Comprehensive Test: Context Managers & Resource Management (PY_230 to PY_235)

slides.title: Resource Management Mastery Review
slides.prompt: This comprehensive test evaluates your understanding of class-based and generator-based context managers, `contextlib` utilities, asynchronous context management, exception handling, and resource lifecycle control in Python.

slides.title: Exception Suppression Return Value
slides.prompt: To swallow an exception inside `__exit__()`, what value must be returned by the method?

slides.title: Generator Context Decorator
slides.prompt: Fill in the decorator name used to wrap generator functions into context managers.

slides.title: Async Context Protocol Methods
slides.prompt: Which set of magic methods defines the protocol for asynchronous context managers?

slides.title: Swallowing Exceptions Utility
slides.prompt: Fill in the helper function from `contextlib` used to ignore specified exception types.
slides.codeSnippet:
from contextlib import ___

with suppress(KeyError):
    d = {}
    val = d['missing']
